notes: shall be the priest's: the copula belongs to the written tihyeh, and the lamed fuses into the English genitive under rule 49's last case, with the assimilated article taking the written the.
The temporal beth before the infinitive takes when and the suffix takes the infinitive's subject pronoun (rules 52, 18).
The article of kisdeh ha-cherem is unrepresented because the ASV writes an indefinite phrase (rule 29), the rectum being rendered attributively as devoted (rule 28).
